claims.claim: Ingersoll Rand acquired Lone Star Blower in August 2026, adding about $50 million of annual revenue and expanding blower, rental and service capability in water/wastewater and industrial applications.

factors.name: water-infrastructure exposure
factors.basis: The acquisition adds equipment and service exposure to water and wastewater treatment, a durable infrastructure need.

risks.risk: Bolt-on acquisition economics depend on integration and realization of expected synergies; disclosed revenue alone does not establish value creation.

unknowns.unknown: Post-acquisition organic growth and realized synergies are not yet established.

claims.claim: Ingersoll Rand's Q1 2026 orders rose 5%, revenue rose 8%, adjusted EBITDA rose 2% to $469 million, and liquidity was $3.9 billion; its initial FY2026 framework called for 2.5%-4.5% revenue growth and $2.13-$2.19 billion adjusted EBITDA.

factors.name: execution resilience
factors.basis: Order/revenue growth and liquidity support execution capacity, while EBITDA growth lagged revenue in Q1 and organic growth assumptions remained modest.

risks.risk: Acquisition contribution can mask weaker organic demand; guidance assumptions should be tested against later reported periods by Alpha.

unknowns.unknown: Scout did not establish the latest post-Q1 full-year guidance revision in this bounded run.
